title: [FS] Prevent duplicate Field Service customer assets during item synchronization
summary: Field Service Integration now prevents duplicate Customer Assets by setting Products synchronized from Business Central Items to not convert to Customer Assets, keeping BC as the source of truth for Customer Asset creation.
key_points: Products from BC Items now have Convert to Customer Asset set to No
Default Item-Product mapping includes the new field mapping rule
Product flag no longer filters Service Items from Customer Asset synchronization
Runtime enforcement and mapping configuration tested
Backward compatible with existing coupled items
quote: Setting Convert to Customer Asset to No for Products synchronized from BC Items.
